messages.help.required_setup.title: Required first-time setup
messages.help.required_setup.body_v003:
1. Enter your VIP level.
2. Equip research gear and enter the in-game Research Speed. Enter a separate boost only when it is additionally active.
3. Before OCR, show the same research category in the game and the tool.
messages.help.levels.body_v003: Click a tree meter or level to change it. In Player Settings, use the −/+ buttons or enter a number. Press Save player settings when finished. Clear resets all research to 0.
messages.help.player.body_v003: Research uses VIP, Research Speed, and Research Boost; construction uses Construction Speed and Construction Boost. Enter 224.84 when the game shows +224.84%. If the entered speed already includes a boost, leave the additional field at 0. Press Save player settings when finished.
messages.help.ocr.body_v003: Show the same research category in the game and the tool, then capture. Confirm the research names and levels, or a destination such as Research Speed, and save in Player Settings after applying. OCR reads only the image and never game memory.

messages.help.paid.title: Speed-up value of packs
messages.help.paid.body: Capture a pack screen to calculate total speed-up time, time per diamond, and included gems. You can manually correct unread items, quantities, prices, and gems. Percentage boosts are excluded because they are not a fixed duration.
messages.paid.no_items: No timed speed-up item was recognized. Enter the items and price manually.

messages.help.title: RLM Research Planner Help
messages.help.introduction: Use this tool to see what research or construction is needed next. Start with the three settings below.
messages.help.tree.title: Using the research tree
messages.help.tree.body:
Browse: choose a category on the left.
Move: drag to pan and use Ctrl + wheel to zoom.
Plan: double-click a research card. Yellow connections are reached; muted connections are not.
messages.help.levels.title: Setting current levels
messages.help.levels.body: Click a card meter or level to change it, then use Save in Player Settings. Before OCR capture, show the same research category in the game and the tool.
messages.help.plan.title: Research plans
messages.help.plan.body:
1. Select a target in the research tree.
2. Review prerequisites, time, and resources; register it as a task if needed.
3. Press Complete on a finished row. Shortest first lists research that can start now.

Technolabes
Normal research uses about 33d 04h of original time as the one-item benchmark. Monster Hunt is the exception and uses more items; the time completed by one item varies by research. Example: 62d 19h 45m with 6 items equals 10d 11h 17m 30s per item, or 31.6% efficiency.
messages.help.castle.title: Construction plans
messages.help.castle.body:
Individual facility example: choose Academy, current 24, and target 25. The required facilities, resources, and time appear automatically.
War Tomes, Steel Cuffs, Soul Crystals, Gold Hammers, and an in-shop gem estimate are totaled separately. After Castle Lv.25, use the post-25 stage to plan Lv.25-1 through Lv.25-5.
messages.help.player.title: Player settings
messages.help.player.body: First enter VIP level, Research Speed, and Research Boost. Read Research Speed in the game while research gear is equipped. For construction plans, also enter Construction Speed and Construction Boost.
messages.help.ocr.title: OCR and safety
messages.help.ocr.body: Show the same research category in the game and the tool, then capture. Confirm the research names and levels before applying. OCR reads only the image and does not access game memory.
messages.help.appearance.title: Display design
messages.help.appearance.body: Use Design at the top of Help to switch between desktop and mobile-style appearances. The choice is saved automatically.
messages.help.data.title: Data and display
messages.help.data.body: The bundled catalog supplies research names, prerequisites, effects, time, and resources. Missing values are shown as Unknown. Operation has been verified with game version v2.200.309; later updates may change values or layouts.
messages.help.license.title: Licenses and attribution
messages.help.license.body: Application code is available under the MIT License. See Data licensing and attribution for research and building data, and Third-party notices for bundled libraries.
messages.help.update.title: Updates
messages.help.update.body: Public builds can check for a new version at startup or with the Check for updates button. The downloaded executable is verified with SHA-256 and replaced after you confirm an app restart.
